train_av_nav_model: train an audio-visual navigation model using a YAML config and specified run type
eval_av_nav_model: evaluate an audio-visual navigation model with configurable checkpoint interval and previous checkpoint index
run_av_nav_experiment: run an audio-visual navigation experiment with a YAML config file and command-line option overrides
eval_best_checkpoint: evaluate the best checkpoint automatically selected from tensorboard logs for an audio-visual navigation model
configure_av_nav_trainer: configure and initialize an audio-visual navigation trainer from a YAML config via the baseline registry
